speckit.name: Full SDD Cycle
speckit.description: Runs specify → plan → tasks → implement with review gates

ocelle-story.name: One Phase: Implement, Review, Fix
ocelle-story.description: Implements one tasks.md phase test-first, then runs red/green-checked review and fix rounds in batches of three; after each batch without approval the operator chooses more rounds, accept or stop

ocelle-implement.name: Implement by User Story with Review Rounds
ocelle-implement.description: Runs the implement, review and fix loop for every tasks.md phase that still needs work, one phase at a time, in tasks.md order

ocelle-spec-check.name: Spec Check
ocelle-spec-check.description: Checks spec.md on its own after specify, fixes blocking findings for up to three checks, then asks the operator to approve the spec

ocelle-plan-squad.name: Adversarial Plan Squad
ocelle-plan-squad.description: Adversarial review of spec and plan after the plan phase: four lenses in parallel, refute, operator forks, fix and verify; then fresh-eyes rounds on the fixes until one confirms nothing (at most three rounds)

ocelle-sdd.name: Ocelle SDD Cycle with Spec Check, Plan Squad and Story Reviews
ocelle-sdd.description: specify → spec check → plan → adversarial plan squad → tasks → analyze, with operator gates, then implementation by user story with review and fix rounds
